source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Mainly crystalloid intravenous fluids on their own, without actually providing any blood products to the client during the emergency","B":"Predetermined ratios of blood products (such as packed red cells, plasma, and platelets) delivered rapidly to address severe, ongoing hemorrhage","C":"A protocol generally reserved only for trauma care settings, with fairly little application within obstetric hemorrhage management","D":"A single unit of blood given without any broader plan in place for further resuscitation if the bleeding continues"}}
source_row.rationale: Massive transfusion protocols provide predetermined ratios of blood products (such as packed red cells, plasma, and platelets) delivered rapidly to address severe, ongoing hemorrhage, applicable in obstetric hemorrhage as well as trauma settings.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose and Components of Massive Transfusion Protocol
